title: Characterization of a fully depleted CCD on high-resistivity silicon
version: 1997-04. Conference paper, Proceedings of SPIE 3019, DOI 10.1117/12.275174, full text displayed in an author-uploaded copy. The Lick Observatory team's characterization includes original measurements on the Berkeley device. All nine authors of the 1996 design report also coauthored this paper, which reports separate Lick-led testing.

passages.note: The characterization paper identifies LBNL as designer and fabricator, reports tests of the 200 × 200, 300 μm CCD and attributes it to previous Berkeley p-i-n detector work. It cites the 1996 CCD design and the 1989 fabrication article separately.
The team tested the back-illuminated CCD at the Lick Observatory 1 m reflector on 4 December 1996, obtaining two images of part of the Orion Nebula.
